description: On liquidation, the charge is max(notional * bountyBps, minBounty) capped at the reserve. For a SHORT on an inverse product whose price collapses, the liquidation notional collapses too, so the charge shrinks to minBounty while the price loss exceeds pledge+claim and is written off against LPs. The settlement plan then always unlocks the reserve remainder (reserve - minBounty) back to the liquidated account as withdrawable settlement, with no condition that write-off == 0. The reserve bucket is isolated from price PnL, and no code path offsets the remainder against the written-off bad debt.
test_note: No test exercises the SHORT write-off path: TerminalPriceWriteoff.t.sol uses a LONG and only checks position removal.
title: Liquidation-reserve remainder is refunded to a defaulting trader when a SHORT price loss is written off

validation.cost: Open the position and its margin; liquidation itself is permissionless and single-transaction.
validation.detect: No guardian reaction is realistic: liquidation is permissionless and settles in one transaction; reactive pause cannot claw back an already-unlocked remainder.
validation.net_roi: Positive whenever reserve - minBounty > position opening costs; scales with reserve size.
validation.result: Defaulting trader withdraws (reserve - minBounty) as free settlement while LPs absorb the written-off price loss.
validation.setup: Inverse product, SHORT position open; price gaps down hard so price loss > pledge + claim; liquidation reserve was locked at open.

description: absorbLoss deliberately does not lower the senior high-water mark (HWM) at wipeout, because the HWM is the senior recovery entitlement. In the preview library, the bootstrap branch (senior==0 && junior==0) assigns seniorHighWaterMark = max(target, amount) absolutely, so a first small recap resets the HWM; the else branch only restores up to gap = HWM - seniorPrincipal, which is then 0, so a second recap is routed entirely to unassignedAssets and stops restoring senior principal. unassignedAssets > 0 also blocks all tranche deposits until the owner assigns it manually.
test_note: Single-recap HWM reset is documented and tested (TrancheRecoveryBehavior.t.sol); no test performs two sequential recapitalisations.
title: Second recapitalisation after a high-water-mark reset is misrouted to unassignedAssets instead of restoring senior principal

validation.call: recordClaimantInflow(Y, Recapitalization, CashArrived) -> settleLpEpoch(0,0) for the second recapitalisation Y
validation.cost: No attacker profit needed: the harm is misrouted recovery funds plus a deposit freeze until manual owner assignment.
validation.detect: Visible only in epoch accounting after the fact; no automated guard reacts.
validation.net_roi: Harm-based (griefing / recovery dilution), quantified as the full second recap amount Y misrouted.
validation.result: seniorPrincipal stays at X while unassignedAssets grows by Y; senior LPs are not restored by the second recap and tranche deposits stay blocked.
validation.setup: Total wipeout of both tranches with a large pre-wipeout senior HWM; a first small recapitalisation X has already reset the HWM via the bootstrap branch.

description: The only terminal path for an expired order with a bounty-ledger mismatch is recovery via clearinghouse.recoverExpiredBounty(...). If that call reverts permanently for a class of mismatch states (the SECURITY.md 'quarantine' states the protocol intentionally preserves), pruning stops at that head order forever: every later order is unexecutable and there is no owner/guardian force-delete.
test_note: Reachability of the permanently-reverting mismatch state from public operations is itself unproven — that proof (or disproof) is the PoC.
title: Global FIFO execution queue can freeze permanently behind a head order whose reservation mismatch is unrecoverable

validation.call: OrderRouter prune/execute attempts against the head order -> OrderRecoverySidecar -> MarginClearinghouse.recoverExpiredBounty
validation.cost: Cost of creating the mismatched expired order, if creatable at all.
validation.detect: The freeze is publicly visible once it happens; there is no in-protocol remedy to detect-and-fix.
validation.net_roi: Harm-based: liveness loss for every queued trader behind the head order.
validation.result: CONDITIONAL: if the unrecoverable state is reachable from public operations, the whole FIFO queue behind the head order freezes permanently. Reachability is not yet demonstrated.
validation.setup: An expired head order whose stored reservation disagrees with the clearinghouse bounty ledger in a way recoverExpiredBounty cannot clear.
